SPECIFICATION & AUDIT LOGIC

Variance Detection Methodology

For each CSV transaction row: Expected_Fee = Gross_USD × ((Published_Base_Pct + Published_FX_Spread_Pct) / 100) + Published_Fixed_Fee. Expected_Net = Gross_USD - Expected_Fee. Fee_Leakage_Variance = Actual_Net_USD - Expected_Net. Rows with hidden fee leakage exceeding max($0.50, 0.25% of Gross) are flagged as FEE_VARIANCE_ALERT.

Frequently Asked Questions

Are my financial CSV rows uploaded to any server?

No. 100% of CSV parsing, fee variance math, and report generation runs inside your browser's local JavaScript memory. No transaction data ever leaves your device.

What does FEE_VARIANCE_ALERT mean on a Payoneer or Stripe row?

It means the actual net settlement you received was lower than the provider's baseline fee schedule—typically caused by an undisclosed 2.5%–3.5% currency conversion spread, an international card surcharge (+1.5%), or an intermediary bank deduction.
